_comment: Generated by screen_watchlist.py from live market data on 2026-08-17. Canonical machine-readable watchlist, loaded by risk_checker (Context.watchlist) and the backtest harness. MUST stay in sync with RULES.md §8 — same drift caveat as risk_checker's RiskLimits. Regenerate by re-running the screener; do not hand-edit.
source: S&P MidCap 400 constituents, filtered against RULES.md §8

criteria.min_news_articles: 6+ across three 14-day probes inside the backtest window
criteria.selection: median-liquidity name per sector (deliberately not the most liquid — that selects for narrative saturation)

_coverage_note: News coverage was verified per-name against the real Alpaca news API inside the Feb-Aug 2026 window, NOT assumed from the sector. The first pass picked ASB and EXLS, which returned ~0 articles — the §5a sentiment veto would never have fired for them, leaving half the decision system inert for 20% of the watchlist. Replaced with RYAN and ALGM, the first candidates in the same sectors' pick order that passed. screen_watchlist.py cannot run this check itself (it runs in the maverick container, which has no Alpaca credentials); run watchlist/check_news_coverage.py in the alpaca-mcp container after any re-screen.
